This is an exciting opportunity to work on high-priority projects supporting customers across Central Government, Defence, National Security, and Critical National Infrastructure . As a Data Engineer, you will work alongside experienced technical professionals to design, build, and maintain robust and scalable data pipelines that ensure data availability, accuracy, security, and performance. You will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders throughout the full project lifecycle, while also contributing to data engineering strategy, technical roadmaps, research, and the adoption of emerging technologies. Location The successful candidate can work from one of the organisation's UK offices, including Bristol, Cheltenham, or London , or work remotely from home. The role will involve occasional travel to customer sites and other company locations when required. Key Responsibilities Interpret, validate, and analyse data requirements across complex environments. Gather, profile, and analyse large-scale structured datasets to ensure data accuracy, quality, and completeness. Design and implement robust ETL/ELT frameworks for ingesting, transforming, validating, normalising, and cleansing data. Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines to support analytics and operational decision-making. Implement data quality controls and prepare datasets for reporting and visualisation. Design and maintain data models to support analytical and operational requirements. Manage and optimise cloud and data storage solutions, including Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, BigQuery, and Snowflake. Contribute to data management standards, policies, governance frameworks, and best practices. Support data synthesis and anonymisation activities to ensure compliance, security, and appropriate data handling. Develop robust data models within secure and highly controlled environments. Monitor and optimise data workflows to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Evaluate emerging data technologies and identify opportunities to improve engineering capabilities. Contribute to data analytics and visualisation strategies. Present technical findings and recommendations to customers and stakeholders. Work collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams throughout the project lifecycle. About You We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and working collaboratively with customers and colleagues. You should have a strong understanding of modern data engineering principles, with experience working in complex or highly regulated environments. The Ideal Candidate Will Have Proven experience working as a Data Engineer within complex technical environments. Strong knowledge of data management principles, including data modelling, integration, quality, and governance. Strong commercial experience with Snowflake and Databricks essential. Experience assessing existing data management systems and recommending improvements. Experience with modern data architectures, including cloud-based and distributed systems. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python. Experience with data engineering and pipeline technologies such as Apache Airflow and Spark. Experience working with cloud platforms, particularly AWS and Azure. Knowledge of big data technologies and distributed data processing. Understanding of data analytics and visualisation. Awareness of data standards, interoperability, data governance, and data sharing. Experience working with sensitive or security-conscious data environments would be highly beneficial. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Security Clearance Due to the nature of the projects and industries supported by our client, the successful candidate will need to be eligible to obtain high-level UK security clearance . To Meet The Current Eligibility Requirements, Candidates Must Hold British citizenship; and Have been permanently resident in the UK for the previous five years. Candidates who already hold relevant UK security clearance are particularly encouraged to apply. Whats on Offer? This is an excellent opportunity to join a technically strong organisation with the culture and flexibility of a growing specialist business, alongside the stability and benefits of an established organisation. The Benefits Package Includes Flexible working: 37.5-hour working week with flexibility around how you structure your time. Hybrid/remote working: Choice of working from home or from a UK office. Learning & Development: Budget available for conferences, training courses, certifications, and other professional development. Career Development: Opportunities to develop your technical expertise and progress your career. Social Culture: Regular team and company social events. Pension: Employer-matched pension scheme. Healthcare: Comprehensive healthcare benefits. Collaborative Environment: A supportive, inclusive, and team-focused working culture. Equal Opportunities Our client is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone is treated fairly and with respect. Applications are welcomed from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of ethnicity, age, gender, veteran status, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or health condition. Reasonable adjustments can be provided throughout the recruitment process for candidates who require them. The organisation is committed to ensuring that all applicants have a fair and accessible recruitment experience. Apply Now If you are an experienced Data Engineer with strong Snowflake and Databricks experience and are looking for your next opportunity within a technically challenging and high-impact environment, we would be keen to hear from you. Apply today to find out more about this Data Engineer opportunity. Qualifications We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and working collaboratively with customers and colleagues. You should have a strong understanding of modern data engineering principles, with experience working in complex or highly regulated environments. Why Is This a Great Opportunity Professional development is an important part of the role. You will be encouraged to take ownership of your career, develop your technical expertise, and proactively pursue opportunities that support your professional goals. You will have the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies and contribute to challenging projects that have a genuine operational impact. Salary Type : Annual Salary Salary Min : £ 50000 Salary Max : £ 70000 Currency Type : GBP

Expertise in variety of programming languages and D&A tool Expertise in cloud-based data solutions and data engineering in the cloud. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Our Mission: To Be Bold and Impactful At Emesent, we build autonomous robotics, LiDAR mapping, and spatial data technologies that are transforming the way industries understand and interact with the physical world. Founded in 2018 with deep roots in Australia's globally recognised CSIRO, Emesent has become a global leader in drone autonomy and mobile mapping solutions. With a rapidly growing international customer base and expanding product portfolio across hardware, desktop software, and cloud platforms, we are entering an exciting new phase of growth and we're looking for engineers who want to help shape what comes next. The Opportunity Cortex is the software and control architecture at the heart of every Emesent scanner. It's what takes you from handheld mapping all the way to autonomously controlling robotic systems connected to it. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Capture team, you'll focus on the software engineering craft that makes Cortex robust and reliable: sound architecture, high-quality code, strong automated testing, and smooth deployment. You'll work hands-on across the stack with a strong focus on the software architecture and deployment of the robotics Cortex stack, from low-level C++ modules to the Python tooling that supports development work, testing, tuning, and deployment. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Capture Engineering Manager, where we're looking first and foremost for depth in software engineering. Key Responsibilities Software Design & Architecture Apply SOLID software engineering and architectural principles across the Cortex stack Contribute to and help evolve the software architecture so it remains scalable, maintainable, and extensible as the platform and team grow Design, implement, and maintain core Cortex modules, including domains such as hardware interface, navigation, mapping, and perception Make sound technical trade-offs and drive design decisions that keep the stack reliable as it scales Software Development Write production-quality C++ for performance-critical components Build supporting tools, test harnesses, and analysis scripts in Python Use Bash for scripting and automation across development and deployment workflows Develop software in Linux-based systems Testing, Deployment & CI/CD Own and expand automated testing and regression pipelines to keep the stack reliable as it grows Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and containerised development workflows (Docker) Deploy and integrate software using the GitHub and AWS ecosystems Validate software behaviours in simulation and on physical hardware, including field trials Collaboration & Mentorship Mentor other engineers in the team, helping build their technical skills and judgement Lead and participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical planning Work closely with hardware, software and product teams to translate customer and field requirements into robust software Document design decisions and share knowledge across the team Assist with support escalations raised by our clients, using the learned feedback to make our software better and more intuitive to use About You You're a senior software engineer who takes pride in engineering craft — clean architecture, high-quality code, and reliable testing and deployment. You operate with a strong degree of autonomy, exercise sound technical judgement, and enjoy raising the bar for the engineers around you. You are effective because you can: Write clean, efficient, well-tested code in C++ and Python Apply solid software engineering and architectural principles to build systems that stay maintainable and scale with the product Design and maintain strong testing, CI/CD, and deployment practices that keep software reliable Communicate clearly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders about progress and trade-offs Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team Experience & Background Our ideal profile is someone with: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Strong proficiency in both C++ (C++20 or later) and Python 3 Working knowledge of Bash Experience with the GitHub ecosystem and AWS deployments Familiarity with build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and containerised development (Docker) A strong track record of automated testing and writing robust, extensible code Track record on working with Linux-based systems A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Nice to have: Some exposure to robotics or embedded systems Familiarity with middleware such as ROS1/ROS2 Experience with robotics simulation pipelines such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim Familiarity with robotics concepts such as SLAM, sensor fusion, path planning, or control systems Familiarity with LiDAR, IMU, or multi-camera systems Experience in agentic engineering, from design to coding However, we encourage people with some, but not all, of this background to also apply. Why This Role Matters Cortex is the software that makes every Emesent scanner work, from handheld mapping to full robotic autonomy — it's what our customers are actually buying when they choose us for GPS-denied mapping and inspection. As a senior engineer on Capture, the quality of your software — its architecture, its test coverage, and how reliably it deploys — directly shapes how our scanners and drones perform in real mines and tunnels, as do the engineers you help develop along the way. The Added Perks 9-day fortnight – every second Friday off Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP) – share in Emesent's success Work alongside a passionate and collaborative team building world-leading technology Genuine learning and development opportunities including LinkedIn Learning access Employee Assistance Program One additional day of leave each year for your work anniversary Novated lease options Why Emesent? At Emesent, you'll work on technology that is genuinely shaping the future of how industries capture and understand the physical world. We offer a dynamic, collaborative environment, competitive compensation, and real opportunities for professional growth. Join us in pushing the boundaries of robotics and spatial intelligence. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Ce poste est en mode (hybride) 2 jours/semaine au bureau de Montréal Agissant à titre de conseiller / consultant de Chrome Technologies, le candidat interviendra auprès de nos clients dans la réalisation des projets qu'ils nous ont confiés. À titre d'Analyste-programmeur(euse) backend, votre rôle consiste à concevoir, à développer, et à faire évoluer des mécanismes de déploiement d'infrastructure multiplateformes reliés aux services de bases de données et de sauvegarde. Vous élaborez des recommandations, des solutions et des plans d'action, selon les orientations et objectifs de l'organisation. Vos connaissances et votre expérience des pratiques DevOps, de développement et d'automatisation CI/CD vous permettent de livrer des produits stables, de constamment améliorer leur qualité et trouver des solutions. Tâches Effectuer l'analyse, le développement et la maintenance des composantes d'infrastructure multiplateformes reliés aux services de bases de données et sauvegarde Appliquer les meilleures pratiques de développement et de sécurité de l'organisation Participer à la livraison et au déploiement continus de solutions Effectuer des revues de code produits par les pairs, pour garantir la qualité, la sécurité et la maintenabilité Documenter les solutions techniques et les pratiques de développement pour faciliter la maintenance et assurer la pérennité des produits Comprendre l'application des technologies dans le développement des solutions de services de bases de données et sauvegarde et la faire progresser dans le but d'améliorer la vélocité de livraison Exigences Expérience approfondie en DevOps et automatisation de processus, avec un fort accent sur l'efficacité opérationnelle et la livraison continue. Expertise avancée de GitHub Actions, incluant la conception, l'optimisation et le maintien de pipelines CI/CD complexes à l'échelle organisationnelle. Maîtrise des intégrations entre plateformes et services d'entreprise : GitHub, Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, APIs REST, Webhooks et autres systèmes externes. review_candidates.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
review_candidates.description: This role can be based anywhere in Australia with remote first work or in Adelaide or Perth with Hybrid working where our offices are located. Critical minerals are the bottleneck in the clean energy transition, and finding them faster is as much a machine learning problem as a geophysics one. At Fleet Space, our satellite-enabled exploration technology helps generate the data and the models to find deposits faster and more efficiently. To help continue to build and scale our products we are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to develop, mature and deploy the models and systems behind that work. You will partner with our another Senior ML Engineer & our Data science team to take research models from notebooks and prototypes through to production-grade products, and you will own the pipelines, GPU environments and infrastructure those systems run on. This is a role with genuine ownership over model quality. You will design leakage-safe evaluation, verify that uncertainty calibration holds as new data lands, and keep every model's lineage reproducible from config through to prediction. You will also own our ML experiment platform: MLflow tracking and the model registry, run identity and provenance conventions, and the environments and dependencies that training jobs run in. Where the platform team has shared infrastructure modules you will reuse them, and you will contribute new patterns back. What You’ll Do Work with the data science team to transition research models into production-ready products, with code quality, scalability and best practice built in rather than retrofitted. Build and maintain robust, efficient ML and data pipelines and the infrastructure behind them, including configuring GPU environments for scalable ML systems. Own model quality across retrain cycles: leakage-safe evaluation, calibrated uncertainty that holds as new data lands, and reproducible lineage from config to prediction. Own the ML experiment platform end to end: MLflow tracking and model registry, run identity and provenance conventions, and the environments and dependencies training jobs run in. Partner with the platform team, reusing shared infrastructure modules where they exist and contributing new patterns back. Write clean, testable Python (SOLID principles) backed by unit tests and automated end-to-end tests. Keep pace with where ML and MLOps are heading, and bring the useful parts back into how we work. What We Are Looking For Deep expertise in machine learning across modeling, engineering and architecture, with proven experience as a software engineer focused on ML. Alignment to our stack; Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), MLflow, AWS, Databricks, Terraform, GitLab, and Zarr and Icechunk for big-array data. Experience with Geospatial data would be a big plus Experience in startup environments, building ML products and environments from early stages Experience across the full ML lifecycle, from data preprocessing and feature engineering through to training, evaluation and deployment. A track record of taking research artifacts (notebooks, scratch apps, prototype models) to production-grade solutions that scale, for example models served as a service. Data engineering from first principles: deterministic, idempotent pipelines, schema and contract discipline at data boundaries, and deliberate failure and retry semantics. Software delivery from first principles: continuous release with automated gates, observability, and clean design in application architecture. Solid grounding in MLOps: model development, deployment and data versioning, ideally in a startup or scale-up environment. Strong Python, with the common data science and ML libraries, and solid software engineering fundamentals across data structures, algorithms and design patterns. Hands-on AWS and Databricks experience, managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and designing to well-architected principles. Experience with code and data version control such as GitLab, MLflow and Icechunk. A high-ownership mindset: you balance technical debt against speed of value delivery and make that trade-off pragmatically. A high-agency mindset: you are comfortable where structure does not exist yet and needs to be built, and you treat iterative delivery as a means to that end rather than a ceremony. Exposure to big-array data such as remote sensing workflows, including Zarr and Icechunk, would be an advantage, as would experience with big data technologies, contributions to open-source ML projects, and comfort working with AI-assisted development workflows such as agentic coding tools and AI code review. About Fleet Space Fleet Space Technologies' vision from the beginning was to build technologies to help humanity explore and connect the Earth, Moon, and Mars.
